name: @innis/coding-standards
description: Deno lint rules and CI check scripts that enforce the Innis coding conventions: clean-architecture layering, no type assertions, parameter and file-length limits, kebab-case filenames, UK English, and the documentation, exports-tested and coverage gates.

tasks.check: deno check lint-plugin.ts check-docs.ts check-exports-tested.ts check-coverage.ts src/ tests/
tasks.coverage: rm -rf cov_profile && deno test -A --coverage=cov_profile && deno coverage cov_profile --lcov --output=cov_profile/lcov.info && deno coverage cov_profile && deno run --allow-read check-coverage.ts
tasks.ci: deno task fmt:check && deno task lint && deno task check && deno task coverage && deno task exports-tested && deno task docs
